Metadata.title: Enes HAN | Portfolio
Metadata.description: Welcome to my portfolio. I am Enes HAN, a full-stack developer based in Germany.

Hero.name: Enes HAN
Hero.description: I am Enes HAN, a full-stack developer experienced with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I build user-friendly, high-performance web applications.

Skills.title: Building apps with modern technologies.
Skills.subtitle: Always close to what is current.

Encryption.description: Secure, high-performance web applications are my priority.

lagerxPro.description: A role-based warehouse management system for small-to-medium warehouses — barcode scanning, stock movements, critical stock alerts, and a TR/EN/DE interface.

dtzB1Meister.description: An AI-powered DTZ A2-B1 exam preparation PWA — Hören, Lesen, Schreiben with AI evaluation, Sprechen practice, spaced repetition vocabulary, and multi-device cloud sync.

hanHandyService.description: A white-label smartphone repair storefront with an integrated inventory admin panel — JWT auth, barcode scanning, stock alerts, and a live product catalog for shops in Germany.

edeHome.description: A modern furniture storefront built with Next.js — product showcase, brand story, and a contact form with email delivery.

handonerApp.description: A modern doner restaurant website built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, presenting menu items and products with a clean, fast interface.

hanmarktApp.description: A modern market app built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, designed to present products with a clean and fast shopping experience.

todoApp.description: A modern task management app with TypeScript, a clear interface, and a fast, reactive user experience.

medikamenteApp.description: A practical medication tracking app for daily use, built with TypeScript.

guessApp.description: A visitor comment app built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Blob Storage for saving and managing messages.

periodTrackerApp.description: A period tracker app that helps women follow their menstrual cycles and access important information.

Datenschutz.metaDescription: Privacy policy for the portfolio website of Enes HAN.
Datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
Datenschutz.introContent: Protecting your personal data is important to me. This website is a personal portfolio. No user accounts, contact forms or tracking tools are used. Below I explain which data may be processed when you use the website.
Datenschutz.hostingContent: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc. (USA). When pages are accessed, technically necessary connection data (e.g. IP address, time, requested resource, user agent) may be processed by the hosting provider to deliver the website and ensure system security. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure and stable operation).
Datenschutz.logsContent: When you visit the website, server log files may be recorded. They are used for technical administration and to prevent abuse. I do not combine them with other data sources. Log data is stored and deleted by the hosting provider according to its policies.
Datenschutz.contactContent: If you contact me by email, the data you provide is processed only to handle your request. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR (pre-contractual/contractual communication) or Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in answering inquiries).
Datenschutz.cookiesContent: This website does not use tracking cookies or analytics services (e.g. Google Analytics). No advertising trackers are used either. Technically necessary storage by the browser or hosting provider may occur as part of delivering the website.
Datenschutz.externalContent: This website contains links to external services (e.g. GitHub, LinkedIn, project demos). When you visit those services, their privacy policies apply. I have no influence on their data processing.
Datenschutz.rightsContent: Within the scope of applicable law you have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection to processing. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. To exercise your rights, a message to the email address above is sufficient.
Datenschutz.updateContent: I reserve the right to update this privacy policy if the website or legal requirements change. The current version is always available on this page.
